homes.name: 11412 Lake Lucaya Dr

loan.lender: Not identified in the records pulled

likes: One story with 4 bedrooms plus a dedicated office and a flex dining space
Rare 3 car garage on a 0.21 acre lot, split bedroom plan
Fenced vinyl yard and a screened covered patio
Lucaya Lake Club amenities: 78 acre lake, resort pool, gym, splash park
watchOuts: Shingle roof is about 11 years old with no replacement listed, so get an insurance quote early
Listing photos are virtually staged, so rooms may feel smaller in person
HOA has pet breed restrictions, worth confirming before you fall in love with it
homes.negotiatingRoom: On the market 119 days and already cut from $465,000 to $425,000, down 8.6 percent. This is a corporate relocation sale, so the seller usually wants a clean, fast close and extra relocation addenda come with it. Trade speed and certainty for price.

homes.name: 12349 Blue Pacific Dr

loan.lender: Confirm servicer with the listing agent

likes: Most square footage on the tour at 2,679 sq ft, and the cheapest at $148.94 per sq ft
Pond view with no rear neighbors, fully fenced yard
Newest build on the tour, 2021 Ryan Homes with a tankless gas water heater and full gutters
Morning room extension and over $36,000 in structural upgrades
watchOuts: Two stories with the owners suite upstairs
Only 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths despite being the largest home here
IKEA PAX closets and the washer and dryer do not convey, and the home sells as is
Farthest south on the tour, so the longest commute for both of you
homes.negotiatingRoom: Best leverage of the four. On the market 156 days with six price cuts, $449,900 down to $399,000, a drop of $50,900 or 11 percent. The listing says motivated sellers and advertises a $5,000 seller contribution. Ask how that $5,000 is structured and whether it can cover closing costs.

homes.name: 11967 Cinnamon Fern Dr
homes.roof: Tile, the only tile roof on the tour

loan.lender: Confirm servicer with the listing agent

likes: One story 4 bed / 3 bath, the only true 4 and 3 on this shortlist
Tile roof, which lasts far longer and helps on insurance
3 car oversized garage with a circular drive on a curved street
Rear bath is already plumbed as a future pool bath, and the backyard is big enough for one
watchOuts: Highest carrying cost of the four: CDD $3,406 a year plus HOA
Seller taxes of $4,345 reflect a long held homestead, so budget much higher as a new buyer
Guard dog and pets on the property, and the home records audio and video
Waterleaf sits off Big Bend, the farthest south of the four
homes.negotiatingRoom: Almost none right now. It listed October 2 and has been on the market 1 day. There is no price history to work from. If you want this one you are competing on terms, not price. The gym equipment in the garage may be available separately.

homes.name: 10415 Alcon Blue Dr

loan.lender: Not identified in the records pulled

likes: Best commute of the four for both of you, close to I-75 and the Selmon
No CDD at all, the only one of the four without it
Conservation pond view, flex room up front, huge owners suite with two separate closets
Small gated community with private roads, and the hot tub and washer and dryer are included
watchOuts: Only 3 bed / 2 bath and 2,056 sq ft for $495,000, which is $240.76 per sq ft
Smallest lot of the four at 0.12 acre
Shingle roof is about 10 years old with no replacement listed
No homestead on it now, so the $8,057 tax bill is close to what a new buyer actually pays
HOA is $191.67 a month, the highest HOA of the four
homes.negotiatingRoom: Thin. Listed September 29 and on the market 4 days. The listing does say the hot tub is included with strong offers, so there is a little room on terms. Send a pre-approval letter with any offer.
